verdict.rationale: OpenCode has no documented first-party cloud-environment configuration. The closest support is its GitHub integration: it runs tasks inside your GitHub Actions runner, and setup walks you through creating the workflow and secrets. That implies the repo's workflow could carry setup steps, but the docs never say so. Missing for 10: a first-party reproducible environment definition, documented dependency and setup-step configuration, environment caching or snapshotting, and any hands-on corroboration.
